# PCA's using LD trimmed Malagasy only data
Choosing number of PC's (K).
"The ‘scree plot’ displays in decreasing order the percentage of variance explained by each PC."

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
setwd("C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity")

dataM_LD <- pcadapt::read.pcadapt(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/Madagascar_full_extracted_clean_auto_no_relatives_LDpruned.bed"), type = "bed") 

#Choose K value 
pca1LD <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = dataM_LD, K=10 , ploidy = 2)

plot(pca1LD, option = "screeplot") 

#Drops sharply after K=5

#Set to K=5
pca1LD <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = dataM_LD, K=5, ploidy = 2)


```


```{r}

fam_Malagasy_LD <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/Madagascar_full_extracted_clean_auto_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))
colnames(fam_Malagasy_LD) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")

groups <- tidyr::separate(fam_Malagasy_LD, IID, into = c("char_prefix", "numeric_suffix"), sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)")
fam_Malagasy_LD <- cbind(fam_Malagasy_LD,groups$char_prefix)

colnames(fam_Malagasy_LD)[7] <- "Group"
fam_Malagasy_LD$Population <- ifelse(fam_Malagasy_LD$Group == "BET","Betsimisaraka",
                         ifelse(fam_Malagasy_LD$Group == "CH","Merina",
                         ifelse(fam_Malagasy_LD$Group == "IR", "Diego",
                         ifelse(fam_Malagasy_LD$Group == "ANT","Diego",
                         ifelse(fam_Malagasy_LD$Group == "NW", "Sakalava/Tsimhety",
                         ifelse(fam_Malagasy_LD$Group == "SH", "Betsileo",NA))))))

PCA_scores_M <- as.data.frame(pca1$scores)

#PCA 1 & 2
ggplot(PCA_scores_M, aes(x = V1, y= V2, color = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population)) +
  geom_point() + #shape = 1
  labs(title = "Madagascar Principle Component Analysis", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Population")

#PCA 3 & 4
ggplot(PCA_scores_M, aes(x = V3, y= V4, color = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population)) +
  geom_point() + #shape = 1
  labs(title = "Madagascar Principle Component Analysis", x = "PC3", y = "PC4", color = "Population")


```



# PCA's of our merged data (so far)
```{r}

data <- pcadapt::read.pcadapt(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_auto_1000G_V_no_relatives_LDpruned.bed"), type = "bed") 

#Choose K value
pca2 <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = data, K=10, ploidy = 2)
plot(pca2, option = "screeplot") 

#Drops sharply after K=5

#Set to K=5
pca2 <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = data, K=5, ploidy = 2)

```

```{r}

fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_auto_1000G_V_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))
colnames(fam) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")
G1000_groups <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/1000G_keep_all.txt"),sep = "\t")
colnames(G1000_groups) <- c("FID","IID", "Population", "Sex")

sub <- fam[fam$IID %in% G1000_groups$IID,] 
missing <- dplyr::anti_join(G1000_groups,sub,by = "IID")
G1000_groups <- dplyr::anti_join(G1000_groups,missing,by="IID")

matching_indices <- match(fam$IID, G1000_groups$IID)
fam$FID <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_indices), G1000_groups$FID[matching_indices], fam$FID)


HG <- fam[grepl("HG",fam$IID),]

sub_HG <- function(x){
  old_prefix <- "HG"
  new_prefix <- x[1]
  x[2] <- sub(paste0("^", old_prefix), new_prefix,as.character(x[2]))
  return(x)
}


res <- apply(HG, sub_HG, MARGIN = 1)
res <- t(res)
res <- as.data.frame(res)

matching_indices <- match(fam$IID,res$IID)
for (i in seq_along(res$IID)) {
  fam[grepl("HG", fam$IID) & fam$IID == HG$IID[i], "IID"] <- res$IID[i]
}

groups <- tidyr::separate(fam, IID, into = c("char_prefix", "numeric_suffix"), sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)")

fam <- cbind(fam,groups$char_prefix)
colnames(fam)[7] <- "Group"
unique(fam$Group)

fam$Population <- ifelse(fam$Group == "BET","Betsimisaraka",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "CH","Merina",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "IR", "Diego",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "ANT","Diego",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "NW", "Sakalava/Tsimhety",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "SH", "Betsileo",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "BJM", "Borneo",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "SA","Khomani San, South Africa",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "GRC", "Sumba and Timor",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "TMR", "Timor",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "KHV", "Kinh Vietnam",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "BEB", "Bengali Bangladesh", 
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "MSL", "Mende Sierra Leone",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "CHS", "Southern Han Chinese",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "PJL", "Punjabi Pakistan",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "GWD", "Gambian Mandinka",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "ESN", "Esan Nigeria",
                         ifelse(fam$Group == "NA", "Yoruba",

NA))))))))))))))))))


pca2$singular.values
variance.explained=(pca2$singular.values)^2 
variance.explained
sum(variance.explained)

PCA_scores <- as.data.frame(pca2$scores)



ggplot(PCA_scores, aes(x = V1, y= V2, color = fam$Population)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Madagascar Principle Component Analysis", x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Population")

ggplot(PCA_scores, aes(x = V3, y= V4, color = fam$Population)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Madagascar Principle Component Analysis", x = "PC3", y = "PC4", color = "Population")
```

# Old version 
```{r}

fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_auto_1000G_V_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))

vietnam_ID <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/vietnamese_ID.txt"))
bangladesh_ID <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/bangladeshi_ID.txt"))

colnames(fam) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")

#Subset to Vietnam and Bangladesh
v <- subset(fam, fam$IID %in% vietnam_ID$V1)
b <- subset(fam, fam$IID %in% bangladesh_ID$V1)

#Change the FID in fam of Vietnam and Bangladesh
fam[fam$FID %in% v$IID, "FID"] <- "Vietnam"
fam[fam$FID %in% b$IID, "FID"] <- "Bangladesh"

#Replace HGO prefix in IID with VNM and BDG
old_prefix <- "HG"
v_prefix <- "VNM"
fam[fam$FID =="Vietnam","IID"] <- sub(paste0("^", old_prefix), v_prefix, fam[fam$FID == "Vietnam", "IID"])
b_prefix <- "BDG"
fam[fam$FID =="Bangladesh","IID"]<- sub(paste0("^", old_prefix), b_prefix, fam[fam$FID == "Bangladesh", "IID"])

GRC_prefix <- "GRC"
t_prefix <- "TMR"
fam[fam$FID =="Timor","IID"] <- sub(paste0("^", GRC_prefix), t_prefix, fam[fam$FID == "Timor", "IID"])

#Split IID into Groups for population ID's
groups <- tidyr::separate(fam, IID, into = c("char_prefix", "numeric_suffix"), sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)")

fam <- cbind(fam,groups$char_prefix)
colnames(fam)[7] <- "Group"

unique(fam$Group)
```
